# MCP tools and prompts

`relgap mcp` serves these tools and prompts over stdio. This page comes from the server's own `tools/list` and `prompts/list` answers. See [relgap mcp](/cli/mcp) for the flags.

## Server instructions

The server sends this text to the client when it connects:

```text
relgap answers questions about upgrading the tools a project pins: what breaks between two versions, which pins are behind, and where repositories disagree. Every result is the JSON envelope of relgap --format json. When the envelope has page.next_cursor, call the same tool with only that cursor to get the rest. Directory arguments must be inside the server's roots; relative ones start at the first root.
```

## Tools

### breaking_changes

Breaking changes. Read-only.

Lists only the breaking changes and deprecations between two versions of a tool, each with its source URL.

Input schema:

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "cursor": {
      "description": "The next_cursor of an earlier result of this tool. Other arguments are then ignored.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "from": {
      "description": "Required unless cursor is set. The version you have. The range starts after it.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "min_confidence": {
      "description": "Hide entries below this confidence, 0 to 1. Default: policy.min_confidence of the config (0.5).",
      "type": [
        "null",
        "number"
      ]
    },
    "to": {
      "description": "The version you upgrade to. Default: the latest stable version on the line.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "tool": {
      "description": "Required unless cursor is set. Tool name or alias, such as terraform, tf or argocd.",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "type": "object"
}
```

### digest

Release-notes digest. Read-only.

Merges the release notes of every version of a tool after from, up to to, into entries grouped by kind (breaking, deprecation, security, feature, fix, other), each with its source URL.

Input schema:

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "cursor": {
      "description": "The next_cursor of an earlier result of this tool. Other arguments are then ignored.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "from": {
      "description": "Required unless cursor is set. The version you have. The range starts after it.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "include_prereleases": {
      "description": "Include prereleases. On when from or to is a prerelease.",
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "line": {
      "description": "Release line the range stays on: none, major or minor. Default: the tool's registry entry, else none.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "min_confidence": {
      "description": "Hide entries below this confidence, 0 to 1. Default: policy.min_confidence of the config (0.5).",
      "type": [
        "null",
        "number"
      ]
    },
    "only": {
      "description": "List only these kinds: breaking, deprecation, security, feature, fix or other. Counts still cover every kind.",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "type": [
        "null",
        "array"
      ]
    },
    "to": {
      "description": "The version you upgrade to. Default: the latest stable version on the line.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "tool": {
      "description": "Required unless cursor is set. Tool name or alias, such as terraform, tf or argocd.",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "type": "object"
}
```

### drift

Version drift. Read-only.

Shows which repositories under the given directories pin different versions of the same tool, from local files only unless latest is true.

Input schema:

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "cursor": {
      "description": "The next_cursor of an earlier result of this tool. Other arguments are then ignored.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "ignore_constraints": {
      "description": "Compare exact pins only. Constraint pins are listed but don't count.",
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "latest": {
      "description": "Add the newest stable version of each tool. Needs GitHub or the HTTP cache.",
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "roots": {
      "description": "Required unless cursor is set. Directories to scan for repositories, inside the server's roots.",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "type": [
        "null",
        "array"
      ]
    },
    "tools": {
      "description": "Report only these tools, each with a column even when it agrees.",
      "items": {
        "type": "string"
      },
      "type": [
        "null",
        "array"
      ]
    }
  },
  "type": "object"
}
```

### outdated

Outdated pins. Read-only.

Compares every tool version pinned in a project directory with the latest release, with breaking-change counts, EOL state and known vulnerabilities.

Input schema:

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "cursor": {
      "description": "The next_cursor of an earlier result of this tool. Other arguments are then ignored.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "path": {
      "description": "Project directory inside the server's roots. Default: the first root.",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "type": "object"
}
```

### resolve

Resolve a tool. Read-only.

Shows how a tool name resolves to a GitHub repository, version rules and changelog sources, with the registry layer behind each field.

Input schema:

```json
{
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "tool": {
      "description": "Tool name or alias (terraform, tf), a NAME_VERSION variable, github:owner/repo, aqua:package, tfprovider:namespace/name, tfmodule:namespace/name/provider, chart:repo/name, npm:package or pypi:package.",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "tool"
  ],
  "type": "object"
}
```

## Prompts

### upgrade_review

Upgrade review.

Reviews the breaking changes and deprecations between two versions of a tool and lists the required actions, citing the entry ID of every claim.

| Argument | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `tool` | yes | Tool name or alias, such as terraform, tf or argocd. |
| `from` | yes | The version you have. |
| `to` | no | The version you upgrade to. Default: the latest stable version on the line. |
